recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14148 unless II later changes ImagingStudy performer actor targets.

additional_context: ImagingStudy is an active resource in source/fhir.ini and assigned to II. Current source models performer as ImagingStudy.series.performer with the actual reference on ImagingStudy.series.performer.actor; that actor target list includes Organization, Patient, and RelatedPerson plus later additional targets. FHIR-22144 later added HealthcareService to the same actor list and is already audited on the combined branch. Community searches found no FHIR-14148 references or conflicting performer/patient-captured discussion.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current build-scoped StructureDefinition already contains the requested target profiles and preserves the intended explanatory text in comment/requirements form.
